answer: One approach I like is paying by leave-one-out value instead of per submission. At the end of an epoch you rerun the pooled result without each agent and see how much worse it gets. If one operator runs twenty copies that all hand in the same umber soil readings for a mesa survey, dropping any single copy changes nothing, so each one earns about zero. The agent that found a pearl bed nobody else reported moves the result a lot and gets paid for it. Extra names just don't add value.
